title: 第5章 自找死路第6章 入剑道
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
“不行。”
李长青摇头，宏声道：“我不允许族内子弟自相残杀，今日世子之争就此作罢，来日再做定夺。”
李天怒视李长青，“族长，李易都答应了生死挑战，你还在偏袒他，难道想让所有李族子弟心寒吗？”
“族长，世子之位本该能者居之，李易现在成为一个废物，你让他继续当世子，如何服众？”
“族长，族规允许族内子弟挑战世子，你一直阻拦，到底什么意思？”
……
不少拥护李天的人高声抗议，群情激愤。
他们见李易失去了真龙圣骨和龙筋，已经成为一个废物，很聪明地选择站队李天，想乘势而起。
李长青瞪着大长老，“李长宏，你真要做得这么绝吗？”
李长宏冷声道：“李长青，我都是按照族规办事，反倒是你处处偏心李易，想以族长的身份给他搞特权吗？”
“你……”
李长青气得脸色铁青。
“族长，你不必阻止，李天打伤我弟，侮辱我娘，今日我必杀他。”
李易死死盯着李天，满脸杀气，他这一生最在乎的就两个人，一个是自己的娘亲，另一个就是自己的亲弟弟。
“呵呵，一个炼气三层的废物，居然还大言不惭说杀我。”
李天讥讽一笑：“李易，你以为自己还是当年那个天才吗，这三年你不进反退，而我早已踏入先天境大圆满，要不了三个月，就能突破至元府境，杀你如屠狗宰羊一般简单。”
李易不再辩解，抱着重伤昏迷的弟弟，扶着母亲，走下演武场。
“易儿，你……”
叶雅面露担忧，一把拉住大儿子的手臂，她才见到失踪三年的大儿子，不想再失去他。
“娘，你放心，我不会再与你们分开。”

李易眼里透着坚定，随后，他转身走向演武场。
大长老冷冷看了一眼李易，见其神态自若，心中隐隐有些不安，来到孙儿李天身边，叮嘱道：“天儿，出手别手软，将他当成你的生死大敌，有什么底牌都给我拿出来。”
李长青脸色阴沉，他知道自己无法阻止这一场生死决斗，因为李易和李天双方都生出你死我亡的决心，就算现在阻止了，随时都会再发生杀戮。
“李天，杀了李易那废物。”
场下，有人大喊，为李天助威，想等李天获胜后，得到青睐。
“李易，给我去死。”
李天身形如风，速度极快，瞬间来到李易面前，手中的灵器小刀闪耀刺骨寒光，朝李易的咽喉割去。
为了一击必杀。
他激活天狼体质，动用上品灵器，使出了最为得意的绝招。
看到这一幕，全场皆惊，没想到他的速度这么快，连在场的元府境高手，都没有看清他的影子，更没想到李天居然有上品灵器。
武器品阶为灵器，玄器，法器，法宝，圣器，道器，帝器，仙器，神器。
在临风城这样的小城，能拥有一件上品灵器，算是极为稀少的存在。
也只有四大家族的族长才有。
有了上品灵器的增幅加持，李天所展现的实力更为强大，几乎达到了元府境初期。
“李易死定了。”
大部分人都生出了这样的念头。
然而。
下一刻，在众人注视中，李易出手如电，以不可思议的角度一把抓住李天的手腕，挡住了对方这致命一击，紧接着，他用力一扭，当场将李天的手臂扭断。
“啊……”
李天发出一声凄厉的惨叫，手中的灵器小刀直接跌落在地。

李易顺势攻击，一个膝击轰在李天的胸部。
咔嚓！
清脆的声音响彻全场，李天的胸部当即塌陷，嘴里喷出鲜血倒飞出去足有十丈远，然后重重落在地面。
整个过程发生在刹那间，李易的动作行云流水，犹如秋风扫落叶一般简单。
全场目瞪口呆，陷入死一般寂静。
content_en:
"No."
Li Changqing shook his head and said loudly: "I will not allow the children of the clan to kill each other. The fight for the heir apparent will be over for now and we will make a decision tomorrow."
Li Tian glared at Li Changqing, "Clan leader, Li Yi has agreed to the life-and-death challenge, but you are still favoring him. Do you want to chill all the children of the Li clan?"
"Clan leader, the position of heir apparent should be occupied by a capable person. Now Li Yi has become a waste. If you let him continue to be heir, how will you convince the public?"
"Clan leader, the clan rules allow the children of the clan to challenge the crown prince, but you keep blocking it. What do you mean?"
…
Many people who supported Li Tian protested loudly, and the crowd was furious.
Seeing that Li Yi had lost the True Dragon Holy Bones and Dragon Tendons and had become a waste, they wisely chose to side with Li Tian and wanted to take advantage of the situation.
Li Changqing glared at the great elder, "Li Changhong, do you really want to be so awesome?"
Li Changhong said coldly: "Li Changqing, I always act in accordance with the clan rules, but you favor Li Yi in everything, do you want to give him special privileges as the clan leader?"
"You..."
Li Changqing was so angry that his face turned livid.
"Clan leader, you don't have to stop him. Li Tian injured my brother and insulted my mother. I will kill him today."
Li Yi stared at Li Tian with a murderous look on his face. There were only two people he cared about most in his life, one was his mother and the other was his biological brother.
"Haha, a waste from the third level of Qi Refining actually has the audacity to talk about killing me."
Li Tian smiled sarcastically: "Li Yi, do you think you are still the genius you were back then? In the past three years, you have not advanced but retreated, and I have already entered the Great Perfection of the Xiantian Realm. In less than three months, I will be able to break through to the Yuanfu Realm. Killing you is as easy as slaughtering a dog or a sheep."
Li Yi stopped arguing, hugged his seriously injured and unconscious brother, supported his mother, and walked down the martial arts field.
"Yi'er, you..."
Ye Ya looked worried and grabbed her eldest son's arm. She had just met her eldest son who had been missing for three years and didn't want to lose him again.
"Mom, don't worry, I will never be separated from you again."
Li Yi's eyes were firm, and then he turned and walked towards the martial arts field.
The First Elder glanced at Li Yi coldly. Seeing his calm demeanor, he felt a little uneasy. He came to his grandson Li Tian and warned: "Tian'er, don't be soft in your attacks. Treat him as your life and death enemy. Show me whatever cards you have."
Li Changqing's face was gloomy. He knew that he could not stop this life-and-death duel, because both Li Yi and Li Tian were determined to kill each other. Even if they were stopped now, there would be another killing at any time.
"Li Tian, kill that loser Li Yi."
Off the field, some people shouted to cheer for Li Tian, hoping to gain favor after Li Tian won.
"Li Yi, go to hell."
Li Tian's figure was like the wind, and he was extremely fast. He came to Li Yi in an instant. The spiritual weapon knife in his hand shone with a biting cold light and cut Li Yi's throat.
To kill with one hit.
He activated Sirius' physique, used high-grade spiritual weapons, and used his most proud trick.
Seeing this scene, everyone in the audience was shocked. They didn't expect that he was so fast. Even the Yuanfu realm masters present couldn't see his shadow clearly, and they didn't expect that Li Tian actually had a high-grade spiritual weapon.
Weapon grades are spiritual weapon, mysterious weapon, magic weapon, magic weapon, holy weapon, Taoist weapon, imperial weapon, fairy weapon, and divine weapon.
In a small city like Linfeng City, it is extremely rare to have a high-grade spiritual weapon.
Only the patriarchs of the four major families have it.
With the increase and blessing of high-grade spiritual weapons, Li Tian's strength was even more powerful, almost reaching the early stage of Yuanfu realm.
"Li Yi is dead."
Most people have this idea.
However.
The next moment, with everyone watching, Li Yi struck like lightning and grabbed Li Tian's wrist at an incredible angle, blocking the opponent's fatal blow. Then, he twisted hard and broke Li Tian's arm on the spot.
"Ah..."
Li Tian let out a shrill scream and dropped the spiritual weapon knife in his hand.Fall to the ground.
Li Yi took advantage of the situation and struck Li Tian in the chest with a knee.
Click!
The crisp sound resounded throughout the audience, and Li Tian's chest collapsed immediately, and blood spurted out of his mouth and flew ten feet away before falling heavily to the ground.
The whole process happened in an instant, and Li Yi's movements were as smooth as the autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves.
The whole place was stunned and fell into deathly silence.
